# Reyem Tech

> Fractional CTO and technology strategy services helping startups and SMBs navigate digital transformation, AI adoption, and enterprise system implementation.

Reyem Tech provides senior technology leadership and strategic consulting across North America, combining fractional CTO services with hands-on software development, AI strategy, and enterprise system implementation (ERP/CRM). The firm specializes in helping resource-constrained organizations scale their technology capabilities without full-time overhead.

## Key Topics

- Fractional CTO
- Digital Transformation
- AI Strategy & Adoption
- Technology Leadership
- Startup Advisory
- Cloud Architecture
- ERP Implementation
- CRM Implementation
- Software Development
- Legacy Modernization
- Change Management
- SMB Consulting
- Tech Strategy
- System Integration
- Data Migration

## Core Services

- [Fractional CTO Services](https://www.reyem.tech/service/fractional-cto): Senior technology leadership without full-time overhead for startups and growing businesses.
- [Digital Transformation](https://www.reyem.tech/service/digital-transformation): Digital transformation services with Reyem Readiness Framework, cloud migration, and compliance standards.
- [AI Strategy & Adoption](https://www.reyem.tech/service/ai-strategy): AI strategy and implementation services for SMBs, including proof-of-concept and vendor selection.
- [CTO-Led Software Development](https://www.reyem.tech/service/development): CTO-led MVP development, legacy modernization, and cloud architecture for startups and SMBs.
- [Startup Advisory Program](https://www.reyem.tech/service/startup-mentoring): Structured startup advisory from pre-seed to Series A with technical roadmap and fundraising prep.

## Enterprise Systems

- [ERP Implementation](https://www.reyem.tech/service/erp): ERP implementation with business process optimization, data migration, and system integration.
- [CRM Implementation](https://www.reyem.tech/service/crm): CRM implementation for Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics with data migration and integration.
